meditations.title: Slow body scan
meditations.description: Attention sinks from your feet to your scalp, leaving each part heavy and warm behind it.

meditations.title: Breath focus
meditations.description: Settle onto the breath — its weight, the still pause before the next one — and let it slow on its own.

meditations.title: Forest path
meditations.description: A windless forest clearing at dusk, held still while the light fades and the quiet settles like silt.
